desc:
🐱 Sneak into 16 worlds, steal a cat and RUN home! The cat runs to its giant boss... and the boss WAKES UP!

⏳ NEW: WORLD 2, TIME TRAVEL! Reach 20Sp, walk through the Gate of Time and steal cats from the Stone Age, Egypt and Rome. A new age every week!

🏠 Your cats make money on your farm every second, even offline.

👟 Train on your treadmill. The faster you are, the further worlds and rarer cats you can catch.

⚾ Hit a thief with your bat and grab his cat!

⚔️ TITAN ATTACK and the SAND EMPEROR: fight them together and win heavy cats!

✨ FEATURES
• 2 worlds and 19 giant bosses
• 150+ cats, from Common kittens to SECRETS
• A Secret cat every :30 Mins
• 2 rare cats in the Spark Pod = an EXOTIC creature
• Every cat has a weight: heavier = richer
• Merge 3 of the same into 1 heavier cat
• New treadmills, trails and bats in every age
• Admin events: the Admin Treadmill multiplies YOUR speed
• Money Tree, daily rewards, English and Arabic

👍 Like and ⭐ favourite for more updates!
